interface.rails.title: Syntax diagram:
interface.rails.description: Follow it like a railway track, left to right and top to bottom. Pills are words written exactly as shown; dashed boxes are slots you fill in; a detour below may be taken or skipped, and a loop back may be repeated.

cadena-caracter.descripcion: At the top, A between single quotes and between double quotes both lead to the Character type. Below, empty quotes and a two-letter text lead to the String type.
cadena-caracter.nota: The content decides, not the quotes

clases-diagnostico.descripcion: Four stages in a column, lexical, syntax, semantic and runtime, each with an example on the right. A red bar next to the first three marks that they are discovered before running.
clases-diagnostico.antes: Discovered before running: they prevent running
clases-diagnostico.nota: Warnings warn but still let the program run

coincidencia-larga.descripcion: At the top, x stuck to the arrow and the 1 splits into x, the assignment arrow and 1: an assignment. Below, with spaces, it splits into x, less than, minus and 1: a comparison.
coincidencia-larga.regla: The engine takes the longest possible piece.
coincidencia-larga.regla2: A space can change the pieces.

comentario.descripcion: Two program lines. In the first, what follows the two slashes is shaded and labelled comment. In the second, the two slashes are inside a quoted text and are labelled ordinary text.
comentario.comentario: comment: up to the end of the line

convenciones.descripcion: Three stacked examples. A code pill with the word If; a dashed slot with the word condition; and a program block with a title, a line number, a Write instruction and, below, a band with the output.

determinismo.descripcion: A box with seed 42 from which two runs leave. Both produce the sequence 1, 1, 6 and an equals sign joins them.

ecosistema.titulo: One language, one engine, three doors
ecosistema.descripcion: At the top, the PseudoLearn language in Spanish and English. Below, the engine that analyses and runs. Three arrows leave the engine towards the app, the command line and the web.

edicion.descripcion: A frame titled 2026 edition with three boxes: a single grammar, a single type policy and a fixed prelude with examples of built-in functions.

error-lexico.descripcion: A Write statement with an at sign between two texts. The at sign is marked in red and an arrow joins it to the diagnostic unrecognizedCharacter. Another arrow shows that the engine keeps reading; a dashed box recalls that no semantic analysis is done.
error-lexico.nota: No values are invented and nothing runs

espacios.descripcion: Two boxes with the same If. The top one has tidy indentation; the bottom one, messy spaces. Below, an equals sign marks that they mean the same.
espacios.igual: = the same program for the engine

familias-palabras.descripcion: Six coloured bands: program structure, subroutines, objects, types, boolean values and operators written with letters, each with examples.
familias-palabras.nota: The full list is in Appendix B

identificadores.descripcion: Two boxes joined by an arrow: the first character, which may be a letter, ñ, an accented vowel or an underscore, and the following ones, which also accept digits and may repeat. Below, four valid names in green and three invalid ones in red.
identificadores.inicio-ej: a–z A–Z ñ á é í ó ú ü _

leer-figura.descripcion: Three stacked instructions joined by arrows: total gets 0, total gets total plus 5, and Write total. Below, a box with the name total and its value. Each step highlights the instruction being run and the value changes from 0 to 5.

leer-raíles.titulo: How to follow a syntax diagram
leer-raíles.descripcion: Three strips of track. The first runs straight through the word While and the slot expression. The second has a detour that goes down to Else and back up, so Else can be skipped. The third passes through the slot statement and has a loop underneath back to the start, so the statement can be repeated.
leer-raíles.fijo: Fixed stretch: follow all of it
leer-raíles.se-salta: straight track: without the optional part

literales-numericos.descripcion: Three rows. Integers: 0, 42 and 2026. Reals: 3.14, 0.5 and 100.0. Not numbers: point 5, 5 point, 3 comma 5, scientific notation and 1 underscore 000.

mapa-partes.descripcion: A diagram of stacked boxes. At the top Part 0 on how to read and Part I with the overview. Below, in two columns, lexical structure and types; then expressions and declarations; then control flow; then subroutines and objects. At the bottom a band with programs, errors, concurrency, library and engine, and another with the appendices.

perfiles-espejo.titulo: The same program in two profiles
perfiles-espejo.descripcion: Two columns, Spanish on the left and English on the right. Each row pairs a word: Si with If, Entonces with Then, Cadena with String. The last two rows show that the name nombre and the text Hola do not change.

posiciones.descripcion: A three-line program on a grid with line numbers on the left and column numbers above. On the second line the x of Write x is highlighted in red, and an arrow joins it to a note explaining that the span starts at line 2, column 12.

punto-y-coma.descripcion: A While block with two statements inside. The two simple statements have a semicolon marked in green; the opening and closing lines have none, marked with an empty-set symbol in red.

si-ordinograma.descripcion: A flowchart with the start, the assignment of estatura, a diamond asking whether estatura is greater than or equal to 120, two boxes with the Write of each branch, the point where they join and the end. Each step highlights the part being run.

terminaciones.descripcion: At the top, the running state. An arrow goes down to a box with the four final terminations: completed, failed, cancelled and limit_reached. Two side arrows lead to the pauses awaiting_input and awaiting_effect, which resume.
terminaciones.pausas: Pauses: once the data arrives, they run again

tres-trabajos.descripcion: A program with three arrows leaving it towards Analyse, Run and Observe. Below each one, what it produces: diagnostics, colours and help; output, termination and failures; trace, memory and timeline. A green line joins Run and Observe because both go through the instructions.

viaje.titulo: The five stages of the engine
viaje.descripcion: A column of boxes joined by arrows: the source text, lexical analysis, syntax analysis, semantic analysis, translation and execution. A dashed red line next to the first three marks that they form the analysis. Each step highlights one stage.
